model.name: Compute and storage platform
model.documentation: The Proxmox hypervisor, the shared Docker VM and the NAS. Solutions run as VMs or LXC containers on the host, or as images on the Docker VM, and store data on the NAS.

element.name: Proxmox host 01
element.documentation: Mini PC hypervisor; the only compute host (see enterprise/bus-asm-single-host).

element.name: VM docker-01
element.documentation: Shared Docker host for containerised solutions.

element.name: NAS
element.documentation: Synology NAS holding solution data (NFS) and running backup jobs.

element.name: Backup jobs
element.documentation: Nightly restic snapshots of Nextcloud data and its database.

element.name: Single hypervisor is a SPOF
element.documentation: All VMs run on one Proxmox host; a hardware failure takes every service down.

element.name: Home lab hardware
element.documentation: Hypervisor, NAS, network gear and UPS (see the compute and network SAs).

element.name: UPS
element.documentation: 900 VA line-interactive UPS; ~20 minutes runtime for host, NAS and network.

element.name: Nextcloud
element.documentation: Self-hosted file sync, sharing and photo backup for the family.

element.name: Nextcloud web
element.documentation: Web UI, WebDAV and mobile sync endpoints.
